name: example-agency-app-shell
title: app-shell page kind
description: A static web-app shell page kind: top nav, grouped side nav, an empty state, one five-row list view, one detail view and a settings page. Fits a team that wants the working frame of an internal tool, not a dashboard of numbers. Composed from six vendored HyperUI application blocks with Tailwind compiled once and inlined; no page kind JavaScript.

query.en: Use the app-shell family for a static web-app shell mock: top nav, grouped side nav, an empty state, a five-row list view, one detail view, and settings. Ask for the tool, its navigation and the working screen a team signs in to see, generate a schemaVersion 2 app-shell typed recipe through the bundled trusted compiler, and render it. This is a page kind, not a decoded client site: every business fact in the reference fixture is a placeholder.
